content.title: Atlético de Madrid v FC Barcelona - as it happened
content.text: Atletico vs Barcelona, 2025/26 Champions League quarter-finals, second leg, 14/04/2026, lineups. BeSoccer Join us for LIVE coverage of the Champions League quarter-finals second leg between Atletico Madrid and FC Barcelona at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano, which kicks off at 21.00 CET. List of goalscorers Match report in news End of match FT: Atletico 1-2 Barcelona. Atletico Madrid have secured their place in the Champions League semi-finals after beating Barcelona 3-2 on aggregate, despite losing the second leg 2-1 at home to a Barcelona side reduced to ten men once again. WHAT A CHANCE! Bardghji's cross from the left flank to the far post is headed wide by Araujo! Araujo fails to head a cross from the left flank. Substitution at Atlético de Madrid Substitution at FC Barcelona Substitution at FC Barcelona Atletico sub: Cardoso replaces Koke. What a chance! Solorth finds Molina with space and the full-back charges through on goal, only to hit a poor effort which is caught by Garcia. Yamal tries to beat Koke inside the box but the Atletico midfielder wins the ball back. Substitution at FC Barcelona Barca sub: De Jong replaces Gavi Eric Garcia sees red card after Turpin reviewed the moce on the monitor. Atletico sub: Griezmann is replaced by Sorloth. Le Normand almost capitalises on a rebound inside the box but the defender's close-range finish is superbly parried by Garcia! Ruggeri returns to the pitch to continue playing with a bandage on his head. The match resumes. Yellow card a FC Barcelona Gavi is cautioned for the foul on Ruggeri. Substitution at FC Barcelona Substitution at FC Barcelona Atletico double sub: Ferran Torres and Fermin OUT. Lewandowski and Rashford IN. Substitution at Atlético de Madrid Substitution at Atlético de Madrid Atletico double sub: Lookman and Simeone OUT. Baena and Gonzalez IN. Great chance for Barca! Yamal dribble past FOUR Atletico players inside the boc before feedin Olmo, who fires his shot over the crossbar! Olmo earns a corner after his 26-yard shot is deflected by Koke. Gerard Martin's cross from the left flank ends in Musso's hands. GOOOOOOALLLLLL TO BARCELONA! Ferran capitalises on the rebound to make it three after Gavi's finish was deflected inside the box... but the goal is disallowed as the striker is caught offside. What a chance for the hosts! Atletico Madrid burst out of the blocks, with Julian finding Lookman on the edge of the box before the Nigerian tried to beat Garcia with a curling effort which went wide oft he post! Yamal tries to find Ferran Torres with space but the Spanish winger's pass went wide. HT: Atletico 1-2 Barcelona. It was a frenetic first half that ended with Barça taking the lead at half-time, though they still needed one more goal to level the tie. The “Cules” levelled the tie in just 24 minutes with an incredible start, thanks to goals from Yamal and Torres, but Lookman reduced the deficit to put Atletico back in control of the tie. Kounde's cross from the right flank is caught by Musso. Lookman is fed inside the box but the forward's finish is blocked by Kounde! Another one for the hosts! Yamal feeds Torres inside the box and the Spaniard's close-range finish is parried by Musso! Griezmann's thumping effort from the edge of the box is blocked by Gerard Martin. Julian fouls Pedri in midfield while fighting for the ball. Goaaaaaal! de Atlético de Madrid en el 31' Statistics of A. Lookman in Champions League 0.23 GOOOOOALLLLL TO ATLETICO! What a counter! Griezmann feeds Llorente on the left flank with space before the Spaniard squares the ball to the far post, where an unmarked Lookman finishes home! Fermin will continue playing. Fermin is being treated as the midfielder is bleeding badly after a hard clash with Musso. Goaaaaaal! de FC Barcelona en el 24' Statistics of Ferran Torres in Champions League 0.3 GOOOOALLLLLL TO BARCELONA! THE 'CULES' ARE ON A MISSION! Olmo feeds Torres inside the box as the striker beats Musso with a low effort across the face of goal. What a chance for the hosts! Lookman dribbles past Kounde inside the box before squaring the ball to the near post where Griezmann finishes off the move but Gerard Martin blocks the Frenchman's finish with a great tackle. Yamal tries to find Olmo inside the box but the ball ends in Musso's hands. The 'Cules' keep possession by moving the ball from wing to wing. Barcelona win the ball back quickly thanks to their high pressing, which makes things difficult for the hosts when playing the ball out from the back. Koke earns a corner for his side after his volley was deflected by Gavi. Great chance for Atletico! Julian Alvarez feeds Lookman inside the box but the forward's volley goes wide! Molina tries to find Griezmann with space but Gavi manages to clear the ball. Goaaaaaal! de FC Barcelona en el 4' Statistics of Lamine Yamal in Champions League 0.6 GOOOOOALLLLLL TO BARCELONA! Yamal receives the ball with space after a poor back pass from Lenglet and the Barca winger beats Musso with a classy finish. WHAT A SAVE FROM MUSSO! The Atletico goalkeeper parries away Yamal's lovely low effort from the edge of the box. Underway at the Metropolitano! Start of match Barca double sub: Olmo and Cancelo OUT. Bardghji and Araujo IN. Players take to the pitch! Barcelona confirmed XI: Joan Garcia, Kounde, Eric, G Martin, Cancelo, Pedri, Gavi, Lamine Yamal, Fermín, Olmo and Ferran Torres. Atletico confirmed XI: J Musso, Koke, Lenglet, Alvarez, Lookman, Giuliano, Griezmann and Molina. Following complaints from Hansi Flick, UEFA inspectors have given the green light to the Metropolitano surface. While regulations allow for a maximum height of 30mm, the grass will be set at 26mm for tonight's Champions League clash. Flick's men face one of their toughest nights in the Champions League, but they will still give it their all to make history in another attempt to overturn the deficit against Atletico, just as they attempted to do in the Copa del Rey semi-final tie. FC Barcelona go into the tie with a two-goal deficit. Hansi Flick’s players need to stage a comeback to stay in the competition – a challenge the club has rarely faced in its history. Barca have only managed five comebacks in Champions League knockout rounds. French referee Clement Turpin will officiate the match. He will be assisted by Nicolas Danos and Benjamin Pages on the sidelines, with Mathieu Vernice serving as fourth official and Jerome Brisard in charge of the video assistant referee system. Barcelona possible starting lineup: J. Garcia (GK); Kounde, Araujo, E. Garcia, Cancelo; Pedri, De Jong; Yamal, Lopez, Rashford and Torres. Atletico Madrid possible starting lineup: Musso (GK); Molina, Lenglet, Le Normand, Ruggeri; Simeone, Llorente, Koke, Lookman; Griezmann and Alvarez. Let's get things warmed up with some possible lineups...
